messages: lina: quick design sync: experimenting with a 'quiet' streaming mode where the compose bar shows only one clear CTA while a response streams. goal: reduce visual clutter (hide/regenerate) and move token info into a compact badge. thoughts? :thought_balloon: marc: sounds promising. important to decide semantics: "quiet" should mean "streaming in progress; regenerate disabled". we should avoid Pause semantics unless we actually support resuming mid-stream. my preference: single button = Stop (terminates stream and enables regenerate). ryan: engineering constraints: if we disable regenerate mid-stream, ensure backend keeps enough context to support immediate regenerate after stop (don't evict KV too early). analytics event names: `playground.stream.started`, `.stopped`, `.regenerate.available` so product can follow. tess: accessibility notes: token badge must be announced via SR but not constantly interrupt. recommend aria-live="polite" on the badge and a separate role="status" element that only announces state transitions (e.g., "Regenerate available"). also use descriptive label on the stop control: "Stop streaming response". violet: copy proposal: primary CTA label tooltip -> "Stop response (Esc)"; when streaming show a faint pill next to the tokens that reads "streaming". token badge copy -> "Tokens: 342". when collapsed (narrow) show just an icon with an accessible name "Token count, 342". lina: layout question: prompt library quick-insert opens a left rail that can overlap the composer on narrow widths. options: 1) shift token badge left of send, 2) collapse into overflow chevron with a disclosure menu, 3) move badge into the quick-insert rail header when open. any strong opinions? marc: prefer 1) shift left of send. Keeps send/token grouping, easier to CSS. fallback: if width < 380px then collapse to icon + menu. ryan: from infra side, we should expose a small helper class to toggle the "quiet" state so other apps can opt in: `.playground--quiet`. will implement in playground-ui branch. also note: keyboard shortcuts: Esc stops, Cmd+Enter still sends new messages after stop. lina: aria example for a11y team to implement: ```html Tokens: 342 ``` tess: small accessibility nit: role/status is usually sufficient for polite updates. avoid assertive unless it's an error. also make sure color contrast for disabled-regenerate meets AA and that opacity changes are not the sole indicator (add textual hint or icon). violet: visual idea: when streaming reduce regenerate to 40% opacity + add `aria-hidden="true"` on the visual-only label so screen readers know it's disabled; show an SR-only text node like "Regenerate disabled while streaming". lina: fallback UX for network interruption: show inline toast under composer: "Stream interrupted — retry" with small retry CTA that rehydrates and resumes if possible. if resume not possible show full stop. ryan, can we detect resumability? ryan: we can attempt resumable streams if session key is retained for 10s and model supports KV resume; I'll add a flag in the response metadata `can_resume` so UI can surface retry vs final stop. marc: action items: 1) design to produce two mocks (shift-left and collapsed icon) — @violet by Tue EOD 2) eng to add `.playground--quiet` + shortcut bindings + resume flag handling — @ryan 3) a11y to validate SR announcements + contrast — @tess 4) finalize copy and QA checklist — @marc. Lina will ship tiny spec doc. lina: thanks everyone. i'll drop the spec and quick Figma frames here when ready. please drop short screenshots or gifs, not long threads. :sparkles:
